input.content:
Biogas plant BGA4 is a custom-built agricultural plant with 250 kW of installed electrical capacity. It is fed along two paths. A cast-in-place concrete pre-pit with an inner diameter of 8 metres and a wall height of 4 metres (gross volume 201 cubic metres) collects the liquid substrates — about 4,793 cubic metres of cattle slurry per year — and pumps them into the digester with a submersible pump. A solid feeder with a 42 cubic metre hopper, a hydraulic push-floor and a mixing screw feeds the solid substrates: 1,729 tonnes of maize silage, 911 tonnes of solid cattle manure, 615 tonnes of chicken manure and 130 tonnes of grass silage per year.

Digester 1 is a cast-in-place concrete tank with an inner diameter of 19 metres and a wall height of 6 metres (gross volume 1,701 cubic metres). It is equipped with two paddle agitators and one submersible agitator, has an internal register heating system with two heating circuits and carries a quarter-sphere double-membrane roof that also serves as gas storage. The digestate flows on into post-digester 1, which has the same dimensions (19 metres inner diameter, 6 metres wall height, 1,701 cubic metres gross), runs with one paddle agitator and one submersible agitator and also carries a double-membrane roof as gas storage. From the post-digester the digestate moves into digestate store 1 with an inner diameter of 34 metres and a wall height of 8 metres (gross volume 7,263 cubic metres), fitted with two submersible agitators and likewise covered by a double-membrane roof.

The biogas from all three tanks passes a gas cooler with reheating and two activated carbon filters for fine desulphurisation and is then converted in a combined heat and power unit with a rated electrical output of 250 kW. A biogas flare with a throughput of up to 300 cubic metres per hour is available for fault conditions. A condensate shaft collects the condensate from the gas collecting pipe. The intended mode of operation is mesophilic.
